svg.title: Red Tunic 5.0.3 — a native PC journey back to Hyrule
svg.desc: Original fantasy-inspired artwork with a crimson cloak emblem, a golden Triforce lit from within, an ember-lit forest, AMD Radeon iGPU tuning, and Steam Deck and Linux handheld focus. Steam Deck performance testing is pending.
